name: DHL
notes: Market cap $71.21B USD for DHL Group (formerly Deutsche Post DHL Group), ticker DHL.DE, Bonn. Headcount 583,998 is the GROUP figure at year-end 2025 including trainees, so it spans all divisions (Express, Global Forwarding, Supply Chain, Post & Parcel Germany, eCommerce) against the listed parent's market cap. Company reports in EUR; the market cap source states its own USD figure, so no manual conversion was applied.
source: companiesmarketcap.com (DHL.DE market cap); DHL Group 2025 Annual Report key figures, reporting-hub.group.dhl.com

name: GE
notes: Figures are GE AEROSPACE only (NYSE: GE, Cincinnati), after the three-way separation into GE Aerospace / GE HealthCare / GE Vernova — NOT the former conglomerate. Market cap $347.49B. Headcount 57,000 is GE Aerospace's own employee count; a workforce-data source gave 58,331 as of March 2026, and the lower company-scale figure was taken.

name: Heineken
notes: Heineken N.V., Euronext Amsterdam HEIA.AS. Market cap €40.16B on 2026-09-08 converted at EUR/USD 1.1611 (rate for 2026-09-08) = $46,630M. Headcount: the company states 'over 85,000 employees' in its own 2025 full-year results; a third-party workforce source claimed ~110,445, a large disagreement, and the company's own figure was taken per the closer-to-filing rule. 85,000 is therefore a floor, not an exact count.
source: theheinekencompany.com 2025 full year results release (headcount); stockanalysis.com AMS:HEIA (market cap); EUR/USD 1.1611 on 2026-09-08

name: Hyundai
notes: Figures are HYUNDAI MOTOR COMPANY (KRX: 005380), Seoul — not Hyundai Heavy Industries and not the wider chaebol. Market cap $76.05B USD; the KRX figure of KRW 80.02T for September 2026 implies ~1052 KRW/USD, consistent with the USD figure, so the source's own USD conversion was used. Headcount 126,407 is Hyundai Motor Company's 2024 figure and is the most recent sourced count; it is two years older than the market cap.
source: companiesmarketcap.com (Hyundai 005380.KS market cap); Wikipedia Hyundai Motor Company infobox, 2024 employees; tradingeconomics.com 005380:KS (KRW cross-check)
